# animation-ready (yellow style)

For animating the logo yourself (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut ...). The PNGs at this level are the whole logo 4096 px wide. The folders hold each part as its own transparent PNG on the same canvas, so they line up when stacked. The layered SVGs have one named group per part.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`icon-layers-style-colour/`](icon-layers-style-colour/) | The icon split into parts, in the style's lettering colour. |
| [`icon-layers-white/`](icon-layers-white/) | The icon split into parts, in white. |
| [`lockup-layers-style-colour/`](lockup-layers-style-colour/) | The stacked lockup (icon, ASTRIS, PRODUCTIONS) with every part on its own layer, in the style's lettering colour. |
| [`lockup-layers-white/`](lockup-layers-white/) | The stacked lockup with every part on its own layer, in white. |
